headline: Maui MPO Policy Board Adopts New Logo & Finalizes Reconciliation

meeting.body: Maui MPO Policy Board Adopts New Logo & Finalizes Reconciliation
meeting.summary: The Maui MPO Policy Board heard that staff finished reconciling past finances and adopted a new logo.
meeting.recap: The board approved the minutes of its September 25, 2026 meeting with no objections.[[0:03:09]] She said a total of $62,394.73 had to be charged to old county accounts to balance the books.[[0:08:42]] An outreach consultant presented a refreshed logo shaped by a survey that 31 people took.[[0:21:35]] The chair suggested spelling out the organization's full name instead of using a short form.[[0:31:19]] The board adopted the new logo with no objections.[[0:34:00]] A state transportation asset plan and performance targets were deferred to next month because the plan is not final.[[0:34:44]] The chair said a meeting was canceled because of storms, so extra meetings are needed to meet the yearly minimum.[[0:35:53]] The next regular meeting is November 12th.[[0:36:21]] Staff are polling members on a second meeting on November 17th.[[0:36:27]]
decided: The board approved the September 25, 2026 meeting minutes with no objections.
The board adopted the new logo design recommended by staff and the outreach consultant with no objections.
meeting.next: The state transportation department is expected to give a short presentation next month so the board can act on the plan. The executive director said the fall TIP revision (a change to the list of funded transportation projects) will be on the second November agenda. The consultant said that once approved, the new look will go on emails, the website and online presence. The executive director said the MPO may request a budget amendment if the partner agency later has a shortfall in its admin funds.

moments.q: Chair explains why the finance reconciliation was put in a memo
